map.安全快门：等效焦距 = 焦距 × 裁切系数，基础快门 = 1 ÷ 等效焦距（秒）: Safe shutter: effective focal length = focal length × crop factor, base shutter = 1 ÷ effective focal length (seconds); from the standard stop table (1, 1/2, 1/4 … 1/1000 s) take the first stop whose duration does not exceed the base shutter (round toward faster); each stabilisation stop allows slowing the shutter one more step (back toward 1 s, at most the 1 s stop) to obtain the final safe shutter. Validation: focal length > 0, crop factor > 0 and stabilisation stops ≥ 0, all numeric; otherwise an input error is shown (no fallback to 50/1/0). Criterion: the scene reference table gives 1/1000 for freezing fast motion, 1/500 for sports, 1/250 for people walking, 1/60 as the handheld limit, 1/15 with a tripod recommended, 2 s for silky waterfalls and other typical stops.
map.计算手持拍摄的安全快门速度，避免手抖模糊: Estimate a safe handheld shutter speed from the focal length to avoid motion blur, useful when setting up a shot.

map.安全快门 t ≤ 1 / (f × k)（k 为裁切系数；经验法则为焦距倒数）: Safe shutter t ≤ 1 / (f × k) (k is the crop factor; rule of thumb is the reciprocal of focal length)
map.依据“安全快门 ≈ 焦距倒数”的经验法则：焦距越长越易手抖，需要更快快门；有防抖: Based on the rule of thumb "safe shutter ≈ reciprocal of focal length": longer focal length shakes more easily and needs a faster shutter; image stabilisation allows a few stops slower, for handheld exposure reference.
map.约 1/焦距秒；防抖镜头可放慢几档，但仍以实测为准。: About 1/focal-length seconds; stabilised lenses can slow a few stops, but trust real measurement.

map.长曝需三脚架，即便防抖也难手持稳住，避免糊片。: Long exposure needs a tripod; even with stabilisation it is hard to hold steady, avoid blurry shots.
